method: TensorCAD class hull calibrated to those particulars (tensorcad.geomquality.baselines.kvlcc2_class): plan form 1-(1-2xi)^a_aft / 1-(2xi-1)^a_fore with a zeta^(1/10) section; ordinates evaluated at run time, no hand-entered numbers
